coda.prompt:

Create a truly NEW and calm scene on that same rooftop at the very start of dawn.
A candid, naturally smiling two-shot across the breakfast counter. The familiar café host, now casually dressed in a clean ochre overshirt with rolled sleeves, stands LEFT behind the counter, leaning forward slightly with one hand open invitingly toward a plate of freshly baked, appetizing golden bagels. Nige, on the RIGHT, relaxed after a very long night, returns his knowing smile, with both hands gently around a single beautifully drawn steaming ceramic coffee cup just below chest level. Match Nige's exact face, big dense curly afro, short neat beard, open olive-green jacket and white T-shirt. The two make warm, friendly eye contact. Compose the mug, open hands, a little silver-and-glass coffee carafe full of coffee, and a ceramic plate of unmistakable whole ring-shaped sesame and everything bagels as a clear still life on the counter, readable even as a thumbnail. Put the counter/plate around two thirds down the frame, with the lowest 16% quieter and clear for separate runtime captions. Faces and gesture should be fully visible above that lower area.
Beyond the canopy is a spacious blue-hour urban skyline reminiscent of Chicago, dark tapered towers, just a thin pale peach glow on the horizon, and only a few golden bulbs glowing faintly overhead. Cool indigo and lilac morning air contrast with warm café light on the characters. Beautiful confident ink contours with richly textured, natural painted color, same visual world and level of finish as the reference shots. Waist-up conversational staging, crisp art-directed shapes and purposeful details, a quiet pocket of city life. SINGLE landscape illustration; no collage or panels.
